```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
library(ggplot2)

theme_tigit <- function(base_size = 12) {
  theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#e6ebf0", linewidth = 0.35),
      axis.line = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.4),
      axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.3),
      axis.title = element_text(color = "#17202a", face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(color = "#52616b"),
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13, hjust = 0, color = "#17202a"),
      plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, color = "#52616b", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 8)),
      legend.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#17202a"),
      legend.text = element_text(color = "#52616b"),
      legend.position = "none",
      plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 8)
    )
}

d <- iris
d$Species <- factor(
  d$Species,
  levels = c("setosa", "versicolor", "virginica"),
  labels = c("Setosa", "Versicolor", "Virginica")
)

fig <- ggplot(d, aes(x = Species, y = Sepal.Length, fill = Species)) +
  geom_boxplot(
    color = "#17202a",
    linewidth = 0.5,
    outlier.color = "#b2182b",
    outlier.shape = 21,
    outlier.fill = "#b2182b",
    outlier.size = 2,
    width = 0.55,
    alpha = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_point(
    position = position_jitter(width = 0.08, seed = 42),
    color = "#17202a",
    alpha = 0.28,
    size = 1.3
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(Setosa = "#9ecae1", Versicolor = "#2171b5", Virginica = "#b2182b")
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Longitud del sèpal a les tres espècies d'iris",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Longitud del sèpal (cm)",
    caption = "Dades: R. A. Fisher, 1936. Exemple docent amb el conjunt de dades estàndard «iris»."
  ) +
  theme_tigit()

output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/boxplot-species-iris.svg")
dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(output, fig, width = 8, height = 4.5, device = svglite::svglite)
```

Dibuixar tres caixes sobre un mateix eix permet comparar centre, dispersió i solapament entre grups, a diferència d'una única caixa que només descrivia la distribució d'un sol grup.")
